platinum.headline: 🎉 Absolutely Flawless!
platinum.body: You showed up every single day without fail. That's rare. That's powerful. That discipline is yours to keep. Carry it into what comes next.

gold.headline: 🏆 Outstanding Work!
gold.body: You pushed through nearly every day. Gold is earned, not given, and you earned it. Keep building on that momentum.

silver.headline: 🥈 Solid Effort!
silver.body: More than halfway there. Silver means you showed up when it counted. Use this as your foundation and push harder next time.

copper.headline: A Start Worth Building On
copper.body: Getting started is step one, but consistency is the real goal. Next time, pick one day at a time and commit to showing up. You have more in you than this challenge showed.

none.headline: This One Got Away
none.body: No days logged this time, and that's okay. Every stumble is information. Take a moment to honestly ask what got in the way, then come back focused and ready.
